hero.title: Smart Business Management for Everyone
hero.subtitle: Froshiar helps businesses manage products, sales, inventory, customers, reports and online stores from one beautiful application.

features.heading: Everything your business needs
features.subheading: An advanced management system, from local warehouse to branded webstore — built to feel effortless and modern.

onlineStore.title: Online Store with Custom Domain
onlineStore.description: Turn your entire inventory into a fast, branded online storefront in seconds with your own subdomains and direct WhatsApp ordering.

inventory.title: Smart Inventory & Barcode
inventory.description: Real-time stock counts across warehouses, fast barcode scanning, low-stock threshold alerts, and one-tap bulk synchronization.

salesPos.title: Fast POS & Smart Receipts
salesPos.description: Lightning-fast counter checkout, custom discounts, multi-tender payments (Cash, Debt, Card), with native PDF and thermal printer receipts.

debts.title: Customer & Supplier Debt Ledger
debts.description: Track total receivables from customers and payables to suppliers, record installment payments, and export professional account statements.

staff.title: Staff Accounts & Permission Roles
staff.description: Onboard staff and cashiers with tailored permission levels, activity audit logs, and complete management from the super admin dashboard.

reports.title: Financial Analytics & Profit Margins
reports.description: Automated net profit calculations, daily and monthly revenue charts, expense tracking, and deep insights into top-selling products.

cloudSync.title: Cloud Sync & 100% Offline Resilience
cloudSync.description: Never stop selling even with zero internet connectivity. Fully reactive offline-first database that seamlessly syncs to the cloud when online.

multiLang.title: Native Kurdish RTL & Dual Currency
multiLang.description: Purpose-built for Kurdish and English with Bahij Janna typography, seamless IQD and USD dual-currency exchange rate conversions.

about.heading: About Froshiar
about.paragraph: Froshiar is an all-in-one business management solution designed for shops, restaurants, pharmacies, supermarkets, cafés and many other businesses.
